# Getting started

## Packages

We'll use the **tidyverse** package for this analysis.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

## Data

The data are available in the `data` folder.

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
#| error: true
survey_raw <- read_excel("data/survey-2026-10-05.xlsx")
```
